body.name: DeepWiki
body.tagline: Ask questions about any public GitHub repository and read its AI-generated DeepWiki documentation.
body.description:
DeepWiki connects your assistant to AI-generated documentation for public GitHub repositories. You can list a repository's documentation topics, read the full wiki contents, and ask questions about the codebase, with answers grounded in its wiki.

It runs as a hosted remote server at https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp using streamable HTTP. A legacy SSE endpoint exists at /sse but is being deprecated. No sign-in or API key is needed for public repositories.
body.verified_by: Verified by mcp.tc: official server from Cognition
